ROI.purpose: Predefined measurement ROI, not a guarantee enclosing all executed trajectories or known traversable environment.

sensor.provenance: All raw ranges, geometry and source stamps checked against saved ROS1 LaserScan bytes; own-source historical odom_from_laser required.
sensor.invalid: Nonfinite/nonpositive/outside original range limits skipped; no synthesized rays.
sensor.endpoint: Native matched-range convention: finite returns clipped at8m, hit only below effective_max−1mm; exact/max boundary is free-only.
sensor.raster: Native grid_cell + supercover_line between endpoint cells; discretization can include portions/centers beyond exact8m metric radius.
sensor.within_scan_motion: One historical TF per scan source stamp; recorded scan time_increment=0 does not enable ray deskew.

area_semantics: Cumulative observed/free-ray/hit-endpoint evidence unions; free evidence may overlap hit evidence across scans or coarse cells. free_without_ever_hit removes all ever-hit cells, and need not be monotone. Neither quantity is GT free space.
observation_sampling: Only one archived real lidar scan per accepted RGBD observation; not every continuously received scan. Sensor/source/phase and capture procedure must be common across pilot arms.

CAN_counter.semantics: Sampled integrated original CAN counters bracketing scan source time; no interpolation or exact cost-at-scan claim. CAN kernel stamps are logged float seconds.

limitations: No ground-truth environment coverage percentage or reconstruction accuracy.
Localization/extrinsic errors affect this independent measurement too.
Fixed common coordinate epoch/registration must be verified across future arms; equal matrices alone cannot prove the same odom epoch.
Sampled CAN cost brackets have finite time uncertainty.
This development sequence is not a predeclared efficacy comparison.
